trafficTypes.Transborder: Travel to or from the United States; US-bound departures use the US preclearance area.
trafficTypes.International: Travel outside Canada excluding the United States in this dataset.

gateZones.scope: Passenger wayfinding zones; not a per-stand arrival/departure authorization matrix.

passengerGateGroups.scope: Labels explicitly printed on the linked maps. Multiple aliases in a group identify a mapped swing gate and share a resource; groups are not a complete current gate inventory.

walkingDistanceScale.description: Passenger-only ordinal walking effort along the concourse from the nearest applicable security checkpoint: 1 is closest, 2-8 are progressively farther, 9 is the farthest terminal/satellite area, and 10 is a remote stand used for passenger service. Values are not metres or walking minutes.
walkingDistanceScale.note: Shared swing aliases receive the same physical-access score. Labels not shown exactly on the supplied image use approximate concourse/neighbor placement; they are listed in inferredGateLabels. The existing passenger gate inventory is preserved. Remote-stand class 10 applies only when passenger use is established separately; it does not classify cargo, maintenance, or GA positions or establish passenger suitability of raw IFATC stands.

airlineTerminals.scope: Directory terminal defaults for named airlines, not exclusive gate ownership or proof of service on a particular date.

ifatcStands.scope: All source rows, including passenger-named gates, remote stands, cargo, maintenance and GA positions. Source type Airline does not establish passenger use.

limitations: Retrieved-on is the research date, not a guarantee that each source is effective on that date. The official linked PDF maps have 2019 filenames.
No complete authoritative per-stand aircraft acceptance, arrival customs routing, adjacency/blocking, or current operating-status matrix was found in the consulted public sources.
Use passengerStandMapping for the explicit simulation crosswalk; do not infer unlisted matches by stripping prefixes or leading digits. Unresolved passenger labels remain unavailable for allocation.
Zone membership is a label classification. It does not mean every B/C gate individually supports both domestic and international flights, or that every shared zone gate is a swing gate.
Mapped swing aliases are mutually exclusive modes of the same resource. Active mode, sterility and mode-change time are operational state, not provided by this static snapshot.

Airline lookups use the operating carrier in flight.carrier, not marketing codeshares. Regional operators and brands not separately listed in the directory require a verified mapping; no terminal is inferred for them.
Terminal defaults describe airline/check-in assignment; IFC and remote-stand use can differ. No exclusive terminal is assigned here to IFC stands.
Stand variants and adjacent positions can overlap. The IFATC list does not establish that all listed positions can be occupied simultaneously.

passengerStandMapping.scope: Explicit simulation crosswalk for 78 canonical terminal passenger groups and 32 H positions. MapComparison rows are editorial spatial/label reconciliations, not certified operational approvals. The 11 excluded passenger labels have no unambiguous IFATC match and are absent from the simulation inventory.
passengerStandMapping.capacityRule: widthClass is the largest IFATC class among the listed alternative stand positions; only one aircraft may occupy a passenger group. Aircraft class must be known and no larger.
passengerStandMapping.blockingRule: Rows with the same conflictGroup cannot be occupied simultaneously, including H A/B subpositions. Alternative stands within a passenger group are not extra gate capacity. Neighbouring groups may have additional operational restrictions not modeled here.
